title: Graves's space situational awareness camera company

tellings.quote: started a small company that is building uh what we believe to be the next generation of space situational awareness cameras

plain: A former US fighter pilot named Ryan Graves says he has started a small company that builds what it believes will be the next generation of "space situational awareness cameras", meaning cameras that watch and track objects moving in space. Graves tells Michels this himself, as his own venture, in an episode about fighter pilots who saw UFOs.
